description: Create, update or destroy a DNS entry in SOPHOS UTM.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The IPV4 Address of the entry. Can be left empty for automatic resolving. Default: "0.0.0.0"

parameters.name: address6
parameters.description: The IPV6 Address of the entry. Can be left empty for automatic resolving. Default: "::"

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: An optional comment to add to the DNS host object. Default: ""

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules. Default: {}

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname for the DNS host object.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.description: The reference name of the interface to use. If not provided the default interface is used. Default: ""

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

parameters.name: resolved
parameters.description: Whether the hostname’s ipv4 address is already resolved or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: resolved6
parameters.description: Whether the hostname’s ipv6 address is already resolved or not. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the object. present creates or updates an object. absent deletes an object if present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout for the UTM to resolve the IP address for the hostname again. Default: 0

parameters.name: utm_host
parameters.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: utm_port
parameters.description: The port of the REST interface. Default: 4444

parameters.name: utm_protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_token
parameters.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en, Chapter 2.4.2.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether the REST interface’s SSL certificate should be verified or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create UTM dns host entry
  community.general.utm_dns_host:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestDNSEntry
    hostname: testentry.some.tld
    state: present

- name: Remove UTM dns host entry
  community.general.utm_dns_host:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestDNSEntry
    state: absent

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The utm object that was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: _locked
return_values.description: Whether or not the object is currently locked. Returned: success

return_values.name: _ref
return_values.description: The reference name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: address
return_values.description: The ipv4 address of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: address6
return_values.description: The ipv6 address of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: hostname
return_values.description: The hostname of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: interface
return_values.description: The reference name of the interface the object is associated with. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: resolved
return_values.description: Whether the ipv4 address is resolved or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: resolved6
return_values.description: Whether the ipv6 address is resolved or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: timeout
return_values.description: The timeout until a new resolving is attempted. Returned: success
